subject: Trading
title: Options vs. Stocks
description: A quick win: understand Options vs. Stocks.

hook.text: Buying 100 shares of a $100 stock costs $10,000. A call option on that stock might cost $300. Same upside, less capital.

buildup.text: Options provide leverage—controlling large positions with small amounts of money. That's both advantage and risk.

discovery.text: Stocks don't expire. Options do. A stock can recover from a dip; an option that expires worthless is gone forever.

twist.text: About 60-80% of options expire worthless. The leverage that makes them attractive is what makes most buyers lose.

climax.text: Options are tools, not replacements for stocks. They're best used strategically—for hedging, income, or speculation.
